signals.text: Delivered scope: the Customers filter on the Tasks page and the Customer field in the New task popup list the customers the sales rep serves, up to 1000, sorted by name; typing in the field searches that list. The customer picker for sharing a shopping list uses the same list (now up to 1000, was 100). PRs: vc-module-sales-rep#33 (Tasks page) and vc-module-task-management#33 (task search).

Explicitly later, not in this ticket: a rep serving more than 1000 customers cannot pick the ones past the first 1000; server-side search while typing, paged loading and Select all (need the new select from VCST-5923 / vc-frontend#2482, come with VCST-6273).
Test environment constraint: deploy both PRs' builds together; with the current task management release the customer and priority filters change nothing (silently ignored, rep gets all tasks).
Known behaviour: on PostgreSQL databases the search box is case-sensitive ("renew" does not find "Renew contract").
Decision (task management): an empty priority now means no priority filter (before, it matched no task); stated as a runtime change in its PR. Empty customers list also means no filter.
Merge blocker R1: the Sales Rep PR pins a prerelease build of task management (3.1007.0-alpha.217); pins stay until task management 3.1007.0 is released, then move to 3.1007.0 and re-run CI.
Filters narrow what a filter rule leaves (not replace it) and match nothing when nothing is left or the rule links tasks to another kind of record (M1, fixed).
Priority/Customer filter changes are debounced 300 ms: one pair of requests (list + calendar dots) per burst; Reset filters applies at once with the day, one reload.

Known limitation M2/C14: a task linked to another record (e.g. a workflow task about an order) cannot take a customer in the popup; saving shows a generic error. 'No customer' saves fine. Not changed in this ticket.

Self-test F1 (major, not fixed, follow-up): search letter case on PostgreSQL combined with the platform search cache that ignores case, so the first casing searched answers for others (search 'quarterly' then 'Quarterly' returns no tasks; 'Renew' then 'renew' returns the same task). Older than this ticket; admin app Tasks search does the same.

Self-test F2 (minor, by decision): Task column is narrow at 1280 px (96 px; 149 px at 1440), long titles show about two words; full title in tooltip and edit popup. Actions column centred in commit 7928374.

Self-test F3-F6 not fixed: focus lost after search Enter (F3, older), focus lost after chip remove/Reset (F4, nit), select summary reads '1 items select...' (F5, ui-kit VcSelect), color contrast below WCAG AA for filter chips 4.05:1 and orange New task button 2.11:1 (F6, theme colors).

Self-test C1-C16 results: smoke, columns (Priority dot red for Highest/High, orange Normal, grey Low/Lowest; '—' when no customer), customer filter, priority filter, status, day and calendar, combined filters, chips and Reset (search term stays), quick picks, popup customer ('No customer' default), data isolation between reps, volume with 120 customers, admin Tasks list, regressions and access passed; not run: segment chips on My customers (no segments in data). A buyer without the Sales Rep permission opening Tasks lands on the account dashboard.
Observed outside this ticket: VCST-6535 (dashboard 'My recent orders' fails when a customer has an order in a currency without a symbol).

materials.finding: Tasks list screen. Title 'Tasks'; 'New task' button; search box 'Search tasks'; filter dropdowns 'All customers' (red-boxed, new), 'All statuses', 'All priorities' (red-boxed); active chip 'Due today' with an x; 'Reset filters' button. Table columns: Task | Priority | Customer | Status | Notes | Actions. The Priority and Customer columns are red-boxed, so they are the changed or new elements. Rows show a priority with a coloured dot (High red, Medium orange, Low grey). The Customer cell shows a customer name, or an em dash '—' when the task has none. Status pills: 'Overdue' (red), 'Upcoming'. Each row has a green check action. A long customer name wraps onto two lines. A month calendar 'May 2026' (Mon-first, today 28 highlighted, coloured dots on days with tasks) sits beside the table, with 'Today' and 'Clear' links. Sample data only; the customer names are not quoted here.

'New task' modal. Fields: 'Task *' (required, placeholder 'Enter task name'); 'Customer' (red-boxed, new; single select, default value 'No customer', chevron); 'Due date *' (required, 05/28/2026, calendar icon); 'Time' (default 'Any time'); 'Priority' (default 'Medium'); 'Notes' (textarea, counter '0 / 250'). Footer buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Create task'. 'Create task' is greyed out and disabled while the Task name is empty. The Customer field is optional (no asterisk).

The Customer select in the New task modal, open. First option is the selected 'No customer', then a plain list of customer names sorted alphabetically (6 visible, list continues). The chevron points up. No search input and no checkboxes, so it is a single select. Contrast with the filter dropdown in image-20261013-093655.

The 'All customers' filter dropdown on the Tasks list, open. It has a 'Search customers' input at the top (focused) and a checkbox beside each customer name (alphabetical), so it is a multi-select with search. The label stays 'All customers' with nothing checked. No Select All, selected-count or load-more is visible in this crop.

hotspots.risk: customerIds is intersected with the organizations the caller serves; ids the caller does not serve must give an empty list (totalCount 0), never the unfiltered list - try an unserved org id, a mix of served and unserved, and an unknown id.

Priorities are narrowed against what a filter rule already allowed (criteria.Priorities); a priority outside the rule's set empties the list. Combine filter=<rule> with priorities and check the intersection.

One unrecognized priority name makes the whole query return nothing (null criteria), even when other names in the list are valid; also numeric strings and 'Low, Normal' must be rejected. Query priorities ["High","nope"] and ["3"].

If a filter rule already restricted the linked object type to something other than the sales-rep customer type, the customer filter returns nothing; sets LinkedObjectType/LinkedObjectIds, which exist only in the task-management prerelease package.

New customerIds and priorities arguments on salesRepTasks (list of non-null String): check the GraphQL schema diff and the failing swagger-validation check; both are optional, so existing callers must be unaffected.
TryParsePriority is shared by the write path (ParsePriority) and the filter; any-case names must still be accepted and unknown names still raise "Unknown task priority" on create/update.

Filter changes reach the list and calendar dots 300 ms after the last pick while chips and selects update at once; check a burst of picks gives one request pair, and that Reset filters (which skips the wait) leaves no stale timer.

The ?filter=overdue link is read once and then removed from the URL; the page then opens with no day picked. A status the project does not offer must fall back to all statuses; a refresh no longer keeps the status.

customerId is now sent for every task type and an empty one is sent as none, which unlinks the customer on update; a link the rep cannot see must survive an edit. Edit a task with a customer, clear it, and edit a task linked to an unserved customer.
The page-reset watcher is now deep over the filters object, so any nested filter change resets the list to page 1 (and a day pick from page 3 must not ask for offset 30); check paging then filtering.

Customer options limit goes from 100 to 1000, loaded once and searched in the browser; a rep serving more than 1000 cannot reach the rest (a logger warning is emitted), and the select draws every option, so check rendering with several hundred customers.

VirtoCommerce.TaskManagement is pinned to prerelease 3.1007.0-alpha.217-vcst-6157-tasks-by-customer in the manifest and in the Data, ExperienceApi and Tests csproj files. A stable publish of this module fails (NU5104) until the pin moves to 3.1007.0, and against task management 3.1006.0 or older the customer and priority filters are silently ignored.

claims.text: The Tasks list gains Priority and Customer columns, and the customer leaves the task's subline.

Above the list sit a search box (a task's name and notes), a Customers filter (several, searchable), a Status filter (one of the project's status rules: upcoming, overdue, completed) and a Priorities filter (several).
The new filters replace the status tabs and their counts.
Each filter narrows what the others leave, the picked day included.
The calendar's dots follow the same filters as the list.
Each applied filter shows as a chip, the picked day too.
Reset filters clears every filter chip, the day included, and keeps the search term.
The calendar's Clear, or a second click on the picked day, shows every date again.
The task popup offers a customer for every task, not only for calls, with "No customer" by default.
The dashboard's overdue notice opens the Tasks page on Overdue across every date (no day picked).
The page opens on today's tasks with a "Due today" chip.
salesRepTasks takes two new optional arguments, customerIds and priorities; each matches any of its values and intersects with filter, period, keyword and storeId.
customerIds fails closed: a customer the caller does not serve matches nothing.
priorities fails closed: a name that is no priority returns nothing rather than the unfiltered list; names are accepted in any case.
There is no schema change, migration, setting or permission change.
The change has no breaking changes at compile, package-upgrade or runtime level.
The Customers filter, the task popup's picker and the list-sharing picker offer the first 1000 customers the rep serves (raised from 100), searched in the browser.
keyword matches a task's name and notes, case-sensitive on PostgreSQL (the collation decides).
Filter changes are sent to the list and the dots 300 ms after the last one, so several picks in a row cost one pair of requests; chips and selects follow each pick at once.
Beside task management 3.1006.0 or older, the customer and priority filters are silently ignored and the rep gets all their tasks back.
The storefront E2E Tasks group now covers the filters, their chips, Reset filters and the dots; the Calls tests read the customer from its column.
SalesRepTasksQueryHandler gains protected virtual ApplyFiltersAsync, ApplyPriorities and ApplyCustomersAsync, and SalesRepTaskHandlerBase gains static TryParsePriority, as extension points.
A save in the task popup, completion toggles and deletes refresh the list and dots without the removed counts query.

hotspots.risk: Select all press: checked clears, unchecked or mixed selects; on a counted partial set whose loaded options are all selected, selected:true adds nothing and the consumer must fetch the rest from @select-all. Check the selection and the emitted { selected, query } on paged, filtered and unnarrowed lists.
Checked vs mixed state: a fully selected page of a set with no selected-count shows checked; with total and selected-count it shows mixed. Look for a counter like '4 of 3000' beside a checked box.

hasSelection: a null model counts as selected only if an option carries null; a wrong answer renders the #selected slot with a null item instead of the placeholder (payment method and shipping method selects) and shows or hides the clear button.

rememberedItem keeps labelling a single-mode value after items are swapped (paging, server search); a stale label could survive after the options change, or the trigger may fall back to the placeholder. Test by picking, closing, and replacing items.

askedAt reset conditions decide when a next page is asked for again; a wrong condition loops requests after a failed page or stalls paging after a rebuilt list (org switcher, paged select). Observe the network request count when a page fails and on a new search.
Guard that stops asking for a collapsed region, a repeated size or no next page; a closed dropdown or a short list that fits the viewport may never request the next page.

Picked ids are mapped back to recipients through the loaded options plus the current rows; an id found in neither is dropped silently, which changes addSharedWithIds/removedIds sent when a wishlist is shared with customers.

A cleared payment-method select now emits undefined and the handler returns early; clearing the control no longer changes the cart's payment method (same early return in shipping method, skyflow card, review sort, returns and orders date-range handlers).

Core contract 0.3.0 with host range ^0.3.0 (federation.mjs:22): a plugin built on ^0.2.x, including the sales-rep plugin, is refused by the host until it is rebuilt; observe plugin loading at /modules.

Current-organization radio now shows when organizations.length > 0 instead of when not loading; while paging or after a failed load the mobile menu may show or hide the current organization differently.

data-test-id="organizations-list" and role=listbox moved from the scrollbar to an inner ul (line 56); E2E selectors and client overrides that targeted the old element, plus keyboard behaviour when the search field is not rendered (tabindex on the ul), may break.

tabindex is now a prop (default 0) applied to the inner element instead of falling through to the outer li; every VcMenuItem consumer that passed tabindex, and hover/dark highlight states (highlightRing default true at line 101), may change focus order or look.

claims.text: VcSelect in multiple mode gains a Select all row with checked/mixed state and a 'selected of total' counter.
Select all acts only on the options on screen: while a query narrows the list only matching options are counted and toggled, and hidden selections are kept.
VcSelect supports paging via has-next-page, loading, total and @load-more; a page too short to scroll still asks for the next one.
@select-all fires on every Select all click with { selected, query }, selected being true when it selected and false when it cleared.
On a paged list with total and selected-count bound, a mixed row selects even when every loaded option is already selected; without them a fully selected page shows checked and a press clears it.
VcSelect emits a debounced @search for every typed query, and server-filter turns the local filter off.
While a query is still in its debounce no next page is asked for, and while it or loading is pending Select all waits and the live region counts nothing.
The #loading slot replaces the spinner of every page and the #empty slot replaces the 'No results found' row.

VcSelectAll is disabled (and the checkbox leaves the Tab order) when there is no option on screen or, with server-filter, a query is unanswered or loading is raised; focus inside it moves to the trigger.

Keyboard: DOM focus stays on the trigger with aria-activedescendant; Enter/Space/Arrows/Home/End follow the APG combobox pattern; Tab moves to the Select all checkbox; Shift+Tab returns to the trigger; Escape closes only the list.
Enter or Space opens the list on the selection; arrow keys and Home/End open it at their own start; pointer opens it with nothing highlighted; only a keyboard-moved highlight draws the focus ring.
New VcLoadMore atom pages from VcScrollbar edges with a required item-count, shows only the spinner of a page on its way, and keeps its role=status region mounted by default.
A failed page is not repeated while the list rests unchanged at its end; scrolling away and back, a smaller count or a rewrite of the rows retries once.
VcScrollbar adds 1px tolerance to edgeThreshold on all four edges so a sub-pixel scroll position at non-1 zoom or DPR still reaches the end.
VcScrollbar renders tabindex=-1 on a region holding an interactive container role and nothing tabbable, and a press on its own area does not focus it.

VcSelect emits undefined on change/update:modelValue when cleared, typed VcSelectEmittedType; handlers across checkout, payment, reviews, returns and sales-rep filters were updated to accept an optional argument.
With multiple + value-field the VcSelect model now holds values, not whole items.
The sales-rep wishlist sharing picker binds ids and maps emitted ids back to recipients, keeping a recipient the reloaded options no longer carry.
A disabled VcSelectButton no longer has pointer-events none: it receives clicks, shows not-allowed cursor, does not open, keeps aria-disabled and renders no clear button.
The header organization switcher uses the same listbox navigation and VcLoadMore; data-test-id="organizations-list" now sits on the listbox ul.
The mobile organization menu keeps the current organization in the list while paging (v-if on organizations.length > 0 instead of !loading).
In dark mode VcMenuItem hover and the new highlighted state use the -50 step instead of -100.
Adds ui_kit.select.select_all, select_all_label and selected_of_total to all 13 ui-kit locales.
@vc-frontend/core contract regenerated and version bumped 0.2.3 -> 0.3.0; plugins on ^0.2.x are refused by the host until they move to ids and ^0.3.0.
Select-all checkbox is sm while option checkboxes are md, and VcSelectButton disabled colours are copied from the base select; both are flagged as needing design confirmation.
